obj.L01.lantern: Take the lantern from the jetty post.
obj.L01.radio: Find where the static is coming from.
obj.L01.power: Restore power at the ghat breaker panel.
obj.L01.leave: Go up the steps to the bazaar.
obj.L02.ledger: Check the ferry ledger at the ticket counter.
obj.L02.restore: Restore the torn lines of the ledger.
obj.L02.signal: Find the source of the radio signal.
obj.L02.hiding: Find Rafi's hiding place in the flooded alley.
obj.L03.culvert: Lower the floodwater using the culvert valves.
obj.L04.reeds: Get past the lookout unseen. Hide in the reeds.
obj.L04.signal: Answer the lights across the creek.
obj.L05.reconstruct: Piece together what happened that night.
obj.L05.decide: Decide what to do with the truth.
barrier.L01.lantern: It's pitch dark past the jetty. I should take that lantern.
barrier.L02.map: Rafi's hiding place is somewhere along this wall.
barrier.L04.creek: The creek is too deep to cross here. Those lights…
barrier.L05.stairs: Not yet. I need to understand what happened down here first.
barrier.L05.door: The wheelhouse door is locked with a gearbox.
barrier.L05.bow: The bow is half underwater. The wheelhouse first.
item.camera.name: Camera
item.camera.desc: Asha's battered mirrorless camera. Still the most honest thing she owns.
item.radio.name: Handheld radio
item.radio.desc: A two-way radio. Mira's voice comes through it, thin and crackling.
item.lantern.name: Hurricane lantern
item.lantern.desc: Karim's old kerosene lantern. Press F (or RB) to raise or lower it.
item.survey_map.name: Survey map
item.survey_map.desc: Sonali Earthworks survey, 2014. Kana Khal is marked in red: 'Fill. Do not survey.'
item.rafi_tape.name: Rafi's tape
item.rafi_tape.desc: The cassette from Captain Jalal's log recorder. Rafi's last words.
clue.rafi_message_1.title: A voice from a dead radio
clue.rafi_message_1.body: The unplugged shelter radio spoke in Rafi's voice: 'Apa… if this ever reaches you…'. The same words as the message Mira's salvaged phone sent.
clue.fuse_diagram.title: Wiring sketch
clue.fuse_diagram.body: Chalked on the tea stall wall: JETTY LAMPS → △, SHELTER → ○, GATE MOTOR → □. Throw the main lever last.
clue.karim_story.title: Karim's story
clue.karim_story.body: Karim, the ghat caretaker, insists the Moynamoti 'left empty' that night, then says his memory is 'a torn net'.
clue.calendar.title: Calendar, July 2014
clue.calendar.body: The tea stall calendar was never turned past July 2014. The 14th is circled twice.
clue.official_notice.title: Official notice
clue.official_notice.body: 'By order: M.V. Moynamoti did not sail on 14 July 2014. No passengers boarded.' Signed by Chairman H. Talukder.
clue.ticket_stub.title: Ticket stub, 21:40
clue.ticket_stub.body: The last ticket sold that night: 21:40, deck class, Shirin Akter.
clue.tea_tab.title: Moni's credit book
clue.tea_tab.body: 14 July: 'Abdul Malek, 2 cups, paid. Left at 9 for the boat. Said five minutes.'
clue.crew_roster.title: Crew roster
clue.crew_roster.body: M.V. Moynamoti crew, 14 July 2014. Master: Jalal Uddin. Helper: Rafi Hossain, signed on 20:50, first aboard.
clue.ledger.title: The restored ledger
clue.ledger.body: 20:50 Rafi Hossain (crew) · 21:05 Abdul Malek · 21:20 Nur Banu + child · 21:40 Shirin Akter. Nine people boarded a ferry that officially never sailed.
clue.radio_tags.title: Repair tags
clue.rafi_message_2.title: Rafi's fragments
clue.rafi_message_2.body: 21:52: the bank at the sand cut collapsed and Captain Jalal turned back for people stranded on the char. 22:10: the ghat landing was gone, so Karim waved them into Kana Khal with his lantern. 22:31: Rafi hid a survey map 'in our place'.
clue.survey_map.title: Kana Khal survey map
clue.survey_map.body: Sonali Earthworks, 2014. The sand cut runs right under the embankment. Kana Khal is marked: 'Fill. Do not survey.'
clue.memorial.title: The painted shutter
clue.memorial.body: Eight small boats painted low on a shop shutter, each with a set of initials. A memorial hidden in plain sight.
clue.earthworks_sign.title: Embankment 'repair'
clue.earthworks_sign.body: Sonali Earthworks' sign calls it a repair project. The mud shows a sand cut dug straight under the embankment.
clue.chalk.title: Chalk on the culvert
clue.chalk.body: Gauge I is fed by valves A and C, Gauge II by A and B, Gauge III by B and C. Marks: I at 3, II at 4, III at 3.
clue.watcher.title: The River Watcher
clue.watcher.body: A tall figure followed me across the bridge. Mira thinks it's Talukder's night man. Or something the river keeps.
clue.karim_lantern.title: Karim's lantern
clue.karim_lantern.body: An old hurricane lantern under a boat in Kana Khal, 'K.M.' scratched into the brass. Karim was here.
clue.shrine.title: Eight garlands
clue.shrine.body: A creekside shrine with eight fresh marigold garlands, tended weekly. Nine were aboard, so one is missing from the mourning.
clue.lights.title: Aleya
clue.lights.body: Lights over the creek answered my lantern, then drifted deeper and led me to the ferry. I can't explain them.
clue.life_jackets.title: Seven of twelve
clue.life_jackets.body: Seven of the twelve life jackets are gone from the rack. The passengers had time to try.
clue.captain_log.title: Captain Jalal's log
clue.captain_log.body: '21:55: diverted to the char, nine aboard. Ghat approach collapsed. Entering Kana Khal by Karim's lantern.' Taped inside: 'Anchor, star, fish.'
clue.gear_wear.title: Worn gearbox
clue.gear_wear.body: On the wheelhouse lock, lever B is polished from use and the first disk's teeth are worn smooth. It was turned often.
clue.reconstruction.title: What happened
clue.reconstruction.body: The sand cut brought the bank down. Jalal turned back for the stranded. Karim's lantern guided them into Kana Khal, which had been cut too. The channel bank gave way and the ferry grounded.
clue.rafi_final.title: Rafi's last record
clue.rafi_final.body: Rafi stayed with the trapped captain after lifting little Tuli onto the roof. He believed Karim would bring help. 'Tell Ma I didn't run away.'
clue.karim_confession.title: Karim's confession
clue.karim_confession.body: Karim guided the ferry in. At dawn only Tuli was alive. Under threat from Talukder he wrote 'cancelled' in the ledger and raised her as his granddaughter.

doc.official_notice.body:
UNION PARISHAD NOTICE

By order of the Chairman: M.V. Moynamoti did NOT sail on 14 July 2014 owing to severe weather. No passengers boarded. The vessel broke her moorings and was lost. Rumours to the contrary are an offence.

— H. Talukder, Chairman

doc.captain_log.body:
LOG · M.V. MOYNAMOTI · 14/07/2014
20:50 Rafi aboard.
21:45 Depart Bakultola, 7 pax.
21:55 Bank at the sand cut DOWN. People on the char. Diverted, took on 2 more. 9 aboard.
22:05 Ghat approach collapsed. Cannot land.
22:10 Entering Kana Khal by Karim's lantern.
—
(taped inside the cover) Wheelhouse lock: ANCHOR · STAR · FISH, as my father taught me.
puzzle.breaker.incomplete: Every circuit needs a terminal before the main lever will move.
puzzle.breaker.trip: The main trips with a spark. Some lamps flickered before it cut out.
puzzle.breaker.solved: The main holds. Power hums back into the ghat.
puzzle.ledger.mismatch: Some lines don't agree with the evidence. Marked lines fit.
puzzle.ledger.solved: Every line agrees with the evidence.
puzzle.radio.misordered: The fragments don't follow on from each other yet.
puzzle.radio.solved: The message plays through in order.
puzzle.floodgate.solved: All three gauges sit on their chalk marks.
puzzle.lantern.wrong: The lights go dark, then begin their pattern again.
puzzle.lantern.solved: The lights answer and begin to drift.
puzzle.wheelhouse.reset: The handle won't turn. The disks spin back to where they started.
puzzle.wheelhouse.solved: The handle turns. The lock gives.
puzzle.reconstruct.solved: It holds. This is what happened.
puzzle.P1.title: Ghat Breaker Panel
puzzle.P1.instructions: Wire each circuit to a terminal, then throw the main lever.
puzzle.P1.hint1: Someone sketched the wiring where they'd see it every day. Check the tea stall.
puzzle.P1.hint2: Each circuit on the sketch points to a shape. The terminals carry the same shapes.
puzzle.P1.hint3: Jetty lamps → triangle, Shelter → circle, Gate motor → square. Then the main lever.
puzzle.P2.title: The Torn Ledger
puzzle.P2.instructions: Match a passenger to each surviving line of the ledger. Use what you've found in the bazaar.
puzzle.P2.hint1: The ticket stub, Moni's credit book and the crew roster each mention a time.
puzzle.P2.hint2: The roster names the crew member who came first; the stub names the last ticket; Malek left the tea stall at nine. The half fare is a mother with a child.
puzzle.P3.title: Rahman's Radio
puzzle.P3.instructions: Tune each band until the signal locks, then put the recovered fragments in order.
puzzle.P3.hint1: Rahman tagged every radio he repaired. The tags are on the shelf.
puzzle.P3.hint2: Each tag gives a band and a number. Watch the waveform settle as you get close.
puzzle.P3.hint3: MW 7, SW-1 13, SW-2 4. Then order the fragments by the times Rafi speaks: 21:52, 22:10, 22:31.
puzzle.P4.title: Culvert Sluice Valves
puzzle.P4.instructions: Turn the three valves until every gauge rests on its chalk mark. Each turn raises the gauges that valve feeds.
puzzle.P4.hint1: The chalk on the culvert says which valves feed which gauge.
puzzle.P4.hint2: Gauge II needs 4 from A and B together. Gauges I and III need 3 each. Try equal turns on A and B first.
puzzle.P4.hint3: A: 2 turns, B: 2 turns, C: 1 turn.
puzzle.P5.title: Lantern Signals
puzzle.P5.instructions: Watch the four-beat pattern across the creek, then answer it with your lantern.
puzzle.P5.hint1: The lights repeat. Count the beats and note where each one shines.
puzzle.P5.hint2: Each position has its own shape: ○ the reed bank, △ the buoy, □ the post. Turn on slow mode in the panel if you need it.
puzzle.P6.title: Wheelhouse Lock
puzzle.P6.instructions: Choose a gear lever and crank to turn the linked disks. Align the disks, then try the handle.
puzzle.P6.hint1: The captain wrote his combination down. Check the log's cover.
puzzle.P6.hint2: Anchor, star, fish. Lever A turns disks 1 and 2, lever B turns 2 and 3, lever C turns disk 1 alone. Set disk 3 first.
puzzle.P6.hint3: Lever B: crank 4 times. Lever A: crank 2 times. Lever C: crank 1 time. Then the handle.
puzzle.R1.title: That Night
puzzle.R1.instructions: Put the events of 14 July 2014 in order, using the log, the map and Rafi's fragments.
puzzle.R1.hint1: Captain Jalal's log has times. So do Rafi's radio fragments.
puzzle.R1.hint2: Something forced the ferry to turn back. Then it couldn't land, and someone showed it another way.
puzzle.R1.hint3: Sand cut collapses → Jalal turns back → Karim's lantern guides them in → channel bank gives way.
puzzle.R1.card.ev.cut: The bank at the sand cut collapses; people are stranded on the char.
puzzle.R1.card.ev.divert: Captain Jalal turns the Moynamoti back to take them aboard.
puzzle.R1.card.ev.lantern: The landing is gone; Karim's lantern guides the ferry into Kana Khal.
puzzle.R1.card.ev.ground: The undercut channel bank gives way; the ferry grounds and floods.
choice.final.prompt: Mira can send Rafi's tape to every newsroom in Dhaka tonight. Karim and Tuli are still within Talukder's reach.
choice.final.A.label: Send the record now
choice.final.A.detail: The names go public tonight. Karim and Tuli face whatever comes next.
choice.final.B.label: Protect the witness first
choice.final.B.detail: Get Tuli and Karim downriver before publishing. The truth waits, but it survives.
ending.A.title: Ending: The Record
ending.B.title: Ending: The Witness
ending.A.card1: The tape aired at dawn. By noon, the names of the eight were read aloud at Bakultola ghat.
ending.A.card2: Chairman Talukder was arrested within the week. Karim and Tuli were questioned for months, their faces on every screen.
ending.A.card3: Tuli stopped going to the market. Karim stopped speaking. But the eight names are carved into the new jetty.
ending.B.card1: Before dawn, Mira's boat took Karim and Tuli to the district town, where a lawyer recorded Karim's sworn statement.
ending.B.card2: Asha published four months later: the tape, the map, the ledger and a living witness. This time the case could not be buried.
ending.B.card3: The families waited one more monsoon. When the names were finally read at Bakultola ghat, it was Tuli who read them.
ending.names:
Rafi Hossain · Jalal Uddin · Abdul Malek · Nur Banu
Shirin Akter · Haripada Das · Kulsum Begum · Sujon Mia
postcredits.card:
Far downriver, on another night of heavy rain, a small light moves against the current.

ALEYA will return.
tip.move: {left}/{right} to walk · {up}/{down} for depth · hold {run} to run
tip.hide: Hold {crouch} in tall reeds to hide
line.L01.asha.arrive: Bakultola Ghat. Twelve years, and it still smells of diesel and rain.
line.L01.asha.message: Rafi's message reached me last week. Twelve years after the river took him.
line.L01.asha.lantern: Karim's old hurricane lantern. There's still oil in it.
line.L01.rafi.fragment: Apa… if this ever reaches you…
line.L01.asha.unplugged: The plug is lying in a puddle. It isn't even connected.
line.L01.mira.call1: Asha? Rafi's sister? It's Mira, from the boat workshop at Char Kalia.
line.L01.mira.call2: I found a phone in the mud when we were clearing the old channel. I charged it, and it sent one waiting message on its own. To you.
line.L01.asha.call3: 'Apa, if this ever reaches you…' Then nothing but rain.
line.L01.mira.call4: You're at the ghat? The gate up to the bazaar runs off the ghat breaker. Get the power back and I'll talk you through the rest.
line.L01.asha.fuse: A wiring sketch chalked on the wall. Jetty, shelter, gate, each with its own symbol.
line.L01.asha.calendar: July 2014. Nobody ever turned the page.
line.L01.karim.1: Who's there? …Asha-moni? Allah, look how you've grown.
line.L01.karim.2: The ferry doesn't come anymore. Not since that night. Moynamoti left empty, they say. Empty.
line.L01.asha.karim3: That is what they say. What do you say, Karim chacha?
line.L01.karim.4: I say my memory is a torn net, child. Go home. The river keeps what it takes.
line.L01.asha.breaker: The ghat breaker. Three switches and a main lever, and every label is rusted off.
line.L01.caption.horn_near: [Ferry horn, close on the river, much too close]
line.L01.asha.horn: Nothing has sailed from here in twelve years.
line.L01.mira.gate: I can see the ghat lights from here. Go up the steps; the bazaar is quiet tonight. Too quiet.
line.L01.asha.gate_locked: The gate motor is dead. The power must be out across the whole ghat.
line.L02.asha.enter: The bazaar. Every shutter down, as if the whole town is holding its breath.
line.L02.caption.radio: [A radio crackles somewhere down the street, then falls silent]
line.L02.asha.notice: 'By order: M.V. Moynamoti did not sail on 14 July 2014. No passengers boarded.' Signed, Chairman H. Talukder.
line.L02.mira.ledger: The ticket counter kept a boarding ledger. If the ferry never sailed, that page will be blank.
line.L02.asha.ledger_found: Not blank. Torn. The names are ripped out, but the boarding times are still there.
line.L02.asha.stub: A ticket stub. 21:40, Shirin Akter. Someone bought passage on a ferry that 'never sailed'.
line.L02.asha.tab: Moni's credit book. Malek left at nine to catch the boat. 'Five minutes', he said.
line.L02.asha.roster: The crew roster. Rafi signed on at 20:50, first aboard. He loved that job.
line.L02.asha.ledger_solved: They boarded. All of them. That notice is a lie.
line.L02.caption.radio_burst: [A radio bursts to life inside Rahman's shop]
line.L02.asha.rahman: Rahman Radio & Electronics. He fixed Baba's transistor for free every monsoon.
line.L02.asha.shutter_up: The shutter's half up. It was never locked.
line.L02.asha.tags: Repair tags. MW 7, SW-1 13, SW-2 4. Rahman wrote everything down.
line.L02.rafi.frag_a: [21:52] Apa, the bank at the sand cut has come down. People are stranded on the char. Uncle Jalal is turning back for them.
line.L02.rafi.frag_b: [22:10] The ghat landing is gone, we can't come in. Karim chacha is waving his lantern from Kana Khal. We're going in there.
line.L02.rafi.frag_c: [22:31] I hid the survey map Uncle Jalal took from the Earthworks office. Our place, behind Rahman's. Where we hid the marbles.
line.L02.asha.our_place: Our place. The loose bricks in the alley wall.
line.L02.mira.kanakhal: Kana Khal was filled in after the 'embankment repairs'. If a map still shows it, Talukder wanted it gone.
line.L02.asha.map: A survey map. Sonali Earthworks, 2014. Kana Khal is marked in red: 'Fill. Do not survey.'
line.L02.asha.map2: Rafi hid this for me. Twelve years in a wall.
line.L02.asha.memorial: Eight little boats, painted on a shutter where no official would look. Someone in this town remembers.
line.L02.asha.alley_blocked: The alley's flooded waist-deep. I'm not wading in blind.
line.L02.mira.exit: The embankment path runs out to the old channel. Careful. Half of it washed away last week.
line.L03.asha.enter: The embankment. Or what's left of it.
line.L03.asha.sign: 'Sonali Earthworks: Embankment Repair Project, 2014.' Repair. They dug the sand out from underneath it.
line.L03.asha.chalk: Chalk marks on the culvert. Someone still tends these valves.
line.L03.mira.valves: Those valves feed three sluice channels. Bring each gauge up to its chalk mark and the walkway should drain.
line.L03.asha.water_blocked: The current over the walkway would knock me flat.
line.L03.caption.sluice: [Sluice gates groan open; floodwater drains off the walkway]
line.L03.caption.watcher: [Heavy footsteps in the mud, closing in behind you]
line.L03.mira.escaped1: Asha? I heard the bank go. Are you hurt?
line.L03.asha.escaped2: Someone followed me. Tall. I never saw a face.
line.L03.mira.escaped3: Talukder keeps a night man on the river. Or the river keeps one of its own. Keep moving.
line.L04.asha.enter: Kana Khal. The reeds have swallowed it whole.
line.L04.caption.lights: [Small lights drift low across the water]
line.L04.asha.aleya: Aleya. Ma used to say they lead lost people further in.
line.L04.mira.lookout: There's an old lookout over the creek. If anyone is up there, keep low in the reeds and move between sweeps.
line.L04.asha.boat: An overturned boat. And a hurricane lantern with 'K.M.' scratched into the brass. Karim Mia.
line.L04.asha.shrine: A small shrine. Eight marigold garlands, still fresh. Someone comes here every week.
line.L04.asha.shrine2: Eight. The ledger said nine people were aboard.
line.L04.asha.pattern: Three lights across the creek. They're blinking… a pattern.
line.L04.caption.answer: [The lights drift deeper into the mist]
line.L04.asha.answer: They're answering me. Or leading me.
line.L04.asha.hull: There. In the mist. A hull.
line.L04.mira.hull: Asha… that's her. That's the Moynamoti.
line.L05.asha.enter: Moynamoti. Twelve years in the reeds, and nobody came looking.
line.L05.asha.board: The deck is tilted. Mind the planks.
line.L05.asha.jackets: The life-jacket rack. Seven of twelve are gone. They had time to try.
line.L05.asha.log: Jalal's log. '21:55: diverted to the char, nine aboard. Ghat approach collapsed. Entering Kana Khal by Karim's lantern.'
line.L05.asha.notes: A note taped inside the cover: 'Anchor, star, fish, as my father taught me.'
line.L05.asha.gears: The wheelhouse lock's gearbox. Lever B is polished bright from use, and the first disk's teeth are worn smooth.
line.L05.asha.ready: I can see it now. I just have to put it in order.
line.L05.asha.reconstructed: It was never just the storm. They cut the bank for sand, they cut the channel too, and then they sent the ferry into it.
line.L05.caption.lock: [The wheelhouse lock turns over with a heavy clunk]
line.L05.asha.recorder: Uncle Jalal's log recorder. There's still a tape in it.
line.L05.rafi.final1: Apa. It's Rafi. The phone won't send, so I'm talking into Uncle Jalal's recorder too.
line.L05.rafi.final2: The channel bank came down on us. We're stuck fast, and the water is in the lower deck.
line.L05.rafi.final3: We got the little one, Tuli, up onto the roof. Uncle Jalal's leg is trapped. I'm not leaving him.
line.L05.rafi.final4: Karim chacha saw it all from the bank. He went for help. He'll bring help.
line.L05.rafi.final5: If nobody comes… tell Ma I didn't run away. Tell her I was working. I was helping.
line.L05.karim.1: I knew you would find her. Rafi always said his Apa was as stubborn as a buffalo.
line.L05.asha.k1: You told everyone she sailed empty.
line.L05.karim.2: Talukder's men cut that bank for sand all monsoon. When it fell, people were stranded on the char. Jalal turned back for them. Of course he did.
line.L05.karim.3: The landing was gone. I swung my lantern to bring them into Kana Khal. I thought the old channel was safe. They had cut that too.
line.L05.karim.4: By morning only one was still breathing. On the roof. The little one. Tuli.
line.L05.karim.5: Talukder said if anyone talked, there would be no ghat, no Karim, and no girl. So I wrote 'cancelled' in the book and raised her as my granddaughter. Twelve years I have carried this.
line.L05.caption.lurch: [The hull lurches; water floods the lower deck]
line.L05.mira.shift: Asha, the ferry is shifting! Get out through the bow, now!
line.L05.asha.go: Karim chacha, go! Off the bow!
line.L05.karim.safe: I am here. I have been running from this river for twelve years. My legs know the way.
line.L05.mira.decide: I can relay the tape from my workshop tonight, to every newsroom in Dhaka. Your call, Asha.
line.L05.asha.endA: Send it, Mira. All of it. Their names, tonight.
line.L05.asha.endB: Not yet. First we get Tuli and Karim downriver, somewhere Talukder can't reach them.
line.L05.mira.endB: My boat is ready. We leave before first light.
